title: Xtra Power one cup Glass Suction Cup, Heavy Duty Dent Puller for Glass, Tiles, Mirror Lifting
description: The Xtra Power one cup Glass Suction Cup is a heavy-duty lifting tool designed to handle glass, tiles, mirrors, and other smooth surfaces with ease. This robust suction cup features a single cup design that creates a powerful vacuum seal, allowing you to lift, move, and position heavy materials safely and efficiently. Whether you're installing glass panels, repairing dents, or handling large tiles during renovation work, this versatile tool provides a secure grip on smooth, non-porous surfaces. The heavy-duty construction ensures reliable performance for both professional tradespeople and DIY enthusiasts. Its compact single-cup design makes it easy to manoeuvre in tight spaces whilst maintaining strong suction power. The dent puller functionality makes it particularly useful for automotive repairs and metalwork applications. Simply press the suction cup firmly against a clean, smooth surface and engage the mechanism to create an instant, secure hold. This practical tool is essential for glaziers, tilers, construction workers, and anyone working with heavy glass or smooth materials, making material handling tasks safer and more manageable.
Name: Xtra Power one cup Glass Suction Cup, Heavy Duty Dent Puller for Glass, Tiles, Mirror Lifting
